items.title: Arhiepiscopul Timotei a sfințit biserica renovată a unei parohii din județul Arad
items.summary: Arhiepiscopul Timotei al Aradului a sfințit duminică biserica Parohiei arădene Satu Mare. Slujba a avut loc cu prilejul finalizării mai multor intervenții de renovare a lăcașului de cult. Au participat clerici de la Catedrala Arhiepiscopală din Arad, de la mănăstiri și din…
items.text:
Arhiepiscopul Timotei al Aradului a sfințit duminică biserica Parohiei arădene Satu Mare. Slujba a avut loc cu prilejul finalizării mai multor intervenții de renovare a lăcașului de cult.

Au participat clerici de la Catedrala Arhiepiscopală din Arad, de la mănăstiri și din parohiile învecinate, precum și membrii ai comunității.

Programul liturgic a continuat cu Sfânta Liturghie, unde Înaltpreasfințitul Părinte Timotei a explicat semnificația Pildei bogatului căruia i-a rodit țarina.

Totodată, părintele paroh Gheorghe-Marius Danciu a prezentat câteva repere din istoria comunității și din activitatea sa pastorală și liturgică în localitatea Satu Mare.

Biserica a rămas deschisă până luni, pentru cei care au dorit să se închine în Sfântul Altar.

Autorități locale și județene, la slujba sfințirii

La slujba de sfințire a lăcașului de cult au luat parte reprezentanți ai autorităților locale și județene, printre care prefectul județului Arad, Marius Sulincean, președintele Consiliului Județean Arad, Iustin Cionca, precum și primarul Comunei Secusigiu, Gheorghe Grad.

Marius Sulincean a subliniat într-o postare pe pagina de Facebook efortul comunității pentru renovarea bisericii.

„Când intri într-o biserică proaspăt rânduită, vezi imediat câtă muncă și câtă grijă au pus oamenii locului în ea. Nimic din ce s-a realizat aici nu s-a făcut peste noapte, ci cu răbdare, dragoste și respect față de credință și față de locul lor”.

La rândul său, Iustin Cionca, președintele Consiliului Județean Arad, a evidențiat semnificația slujbei de sfințire: „Credința și tradițiile sunt parte din identitatea comunităților noastre, iar astfel de momente ne reamintesc cât de important este să păstrăm vii aceste valori”.

Lucrări de amenajare și reabilitare au inclus casa parohială și curtea lăcașului de cult.

items.text:
Întâlnirea Tinerilor din Protopopiatul Reghin a reunit sâmbătă peste 1.000 de participanți sub genericul „Tânărul între online și offline. Biserica – marea familie a prieteniilor adevărate”.

Invitații manifestării au fost Mircea Popa, cunoscut în online drept Mircea Bravo, și Elena Moldovan, cunoscută ca Bunica din Chinteni.

Aceștia le-au vorbit tinerilor despre faptul că mediul online nu trebuie să creeze dependență sau să devină loc al risipirii timpului.

Bunica Lenuța a subliniat importanța relației personale cu Dumnezeu, prin prezența în viața Bisericii. De asemenea, i-a îndemnat pe cei prezenți să rămână autentici și sinceri în căutările lor, fără a se lăsa manipulați de moda vremii.

Corul Ligii Tinerilor Creștin-Ortodocși, dirijat de Iustin Chiorean, alături de tinerele Adelina și Alexandra Pop, Gizella Ianko și Andrada Șerbănaț, a susținut un recital de muzică religioasă.

La final, Protopopul de Reghin, părintele Valentin Vârva, a transmis cuvântul de binecuvântare al Arhiepiscopului Irineu al Alba Iuliei, subliniind importanța acestor întâlniri anuale pentru tinerii de pe raza protopopiatului.

items.sum: Sinodin Eparkial të Shenjtë të Kryedioqezës së Australisë do të mblidhet për një sesion të jashtëzakonshëm nga e marta, 24 nëntor deri të premten, 27 nëntor të këtij viti, në Sidnei, nën presidencën e kryepeshkopit Makarios të Australisë.
items.text_orig:
The Holy Eparchial Synod of the Archdiocese of Australia will convene for an extraordinary session from Tuesday, 24 November, to Friday, 27 November of this year, in Sydney, under the presidency of Archbishop Makarios of Australia.

During its proceedings, the Holy Eparchial Synod will examine the matters listed on its Agenda, concerning the overall life, pastoral ministry and orderly functioning of the Holy Archdiocese of Australia, as well as the progress of Greek education and the Greek language.

Throughout the proceedings of the Holy Synod, the Christ-loving faithful of the Archdiocese of Australia will be informed of its decisions through relevant official announcements.

items.title_orig: Georgian Patriarch welcomes surrogacy ban, says practice is linked to several grave sins
items.sum:
Catholicos-Patriark Shio III i të gjithë Gjeorgjisë përshëndeti vendimin e qeverisë gjeorgjiane të ndalimit të surrogatit, duke e përshkruar nismën si një hap të rëndësishëm drejt përtëritjes shpirtërore dhe morale të vendit.

Sipas mediumeve gjeorgjiane, duke folur gjatë një predikimi në kishën e Shën Ninos në manastirin Bodbe, patriarku shprehu kënaqësinë e tij me njoftimin, duke theksuar se vendimi pasqyronte vlerat e krishtere dhe rëndësinë e bashkëpunimit midis Kishës dhe shtetit.

Të gjithë ne e mirëpresim thellësisht këtë vendim, deklaroi patriarku.

Kryeministri gjeorgjian vë në dukje bashkëpunimin kishë-shtet

Duke folur në manastirin Bodbe, Kryeministri gjeorgjian Irakli Kobakhidze theksoi rëndësinë e bashkëpunimit midis kishës orthodhokse gjeorgjiane dhe shtetit, sipas të njëjtave degë.

Bashkimi midis kishës dhe shtetit, midis shtetit dhe kishës, është me rëndësi të madhe dhe sot jemi të kënaqur që mund të kujdesemi për vendin tonë së bashku në unitet, tha Kobakhidze.

Kryetari i parlamentit Shalva Papuashvili ju drejtua gjithashtu atyre të mbledhur në manastirin Bodbe, duke theksuar marrëdhëniet historike midis kishës gjeorgjiane dhe shtetit, siç raportohet nga mediat gjeorgjiane.

Atdheu ishte lutja e vazhdueshme dhe shqetësimi kryesor i patriarkut tonë të vdekur, Ilia II, tha Papuashvili, duke shtuar se ish - patriarku kishte punuar gjatë gjithë jetës së tij për të forcuar bashkëpunimin midis Kishës dhe shtetit.
items.text_orig:
Catholicos-Patriarch Shio III of All Georgia welcomed the Georgian government’s decision to ban surrogacy, describing the initiative as a significant step toward the spiritual and moral renewal of the country.

According to Georgian media outlets, speaking during a sermon at the Church of Saint Nino at Bodbe Monastery, the Patriarch expressed his satisfaction with the announcement, emphasizing that the decision reflected Christian values and the importance of cooperation between the Church and the State.

“Banning surrogacy in our country will be a major step forward towards the spiritual and moral renewal of our nation, and we all deeply welcome this decision,” the Patriarch stated.

He argued that surrogacy was associated with several serious sins and expressed hope that the proposed legislation would be successfully implemented.

“We pray that God, Saint George and Saint Nino grant you the strength to carry it out and see it through to completion,” he said.

Patriarch Shio III also revealed that the initiative had been preceded by discussions between Church and State representatives on surrogacy and other pressing issues.

“I am deeply gratified that this decision stems from your Christian worldview and from your genuine concern for our Church and for strengthening and instilling Christian, traditional values in our country,” he added.

The parliamentary majority announced its decision to ban surrogacy in Georgia on November 22, stating that the relevant legislation would soon be submitted to Parliament.

Georgian Prime Minister Highlights Church-State Cooperation

Speaking at Bodbe Monastery, Georgian Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze emphasized the importance of cooperation between the Georgian Orthodox Church and the State , according to the same outlets.

“Unity between Church and State, between State and Church, is of utmost importance, and today we are glad that we can care for our country together in unity,” Kobakhidze said.

The Prime Minister thanked the hierarchs, members of the Holy Synod, and clergy for their contribution to strengthening both the Church and the country.

“Every one of you has rendered truly exceptional service. You cherish our Mother Church and care for the strength of both our Mother Church and our homeland,” he stated.

He concluded by extending his wishes on the feast of Saint George, known in Georgia as Giorgoba, invoking the protection of Saint George, Saint Nino, and God upon the nation.

Parliament Speaker Pays Tribute to Patriarch Ilia II

Parliament Speaker Shalva Papuashvili also addressed those gathered at Bodbe Monastery, highlighting the historical relationship between the Georgian Church and the State, as reported by Georgian media outlets.

Referring to the 1,700th anniversary of Christianity’s proclamation as the state religion of Georgia, Papuashvili emphasized the importance of national and ecclesiastical unity.

He paid tribute to the late Patriarch Ilia II, describing unity as one of the central concerns of his ministry.

“Unity was the constant prayer and foremost concern of our late Patriarch, Ilia II,” Papuashvili said, adding that the former Patriarch had worked throughout his life to strengthen cooperation between the Church and the State.

According to the Parliament Speaker, Patriarch Ilia II demonstrated through his actions how religious and political institutions could work together during difficult periods.

“Today, walking this path is easier because we have the example of Ilia II before us. We need only ask ourselves how Ilia II would have acted in a given situation,” he noted.

Papuashvili also recalled a saying frequently repeated by the late Patriarch: “The devil divides; God unites.”

He described the Georgian Church and the State as two pillars of national life, arguing that their cooperation was essential for preserving the country’s historical identity and ensuring its future.

“In the strength, steadfastness and shared responsibility of these two pillars lies the remembrance of our nation’s past, the understanding of our present, and the hope for our nation’s future,” he concluded.

The statements were made during celebrations marking the feast of Saint George at Bodbe Monastery, where Saint Nino, the Enlightener of Georgia, is buried.

Photos: 1tv.ge

items.title_orig: Spain approves social security coverage for Romanian Orthodox clergy
items.sum:
Këshilli i Ministrave i Spanjës miratoi përfshirjen e klerit orthodhoks rumun që shërben në vend në skemën e tij të Përgjithshme të Sigurisë Sociale në 17 nëntor. Priftërinjtë orthodhoksë rumunë do të trajtohen si punonjës për qëllime të sigurimeve shoqërore, mbi bazën e një çertifikate lëshuar nga Dioqeza orthodhokse rumune e Spanjës dhe Portugalisë.

Prandaj kleri orthodhoks rumun në Spanjë do të ketë të drejtën e pensioneve të pensionit, pensioneve të përhershme të paaftësisë, granteve të vdekjes dhe të mbijetuarve prej tyre.

"Periodët e aktivitetit të kryer në territorin spanjoll si ministër i Kishës Orthodhokse Rumune në Spanjë përpara hyrjes në fuqi të këtij dekreti mbretëror do të njihen si periudha kontributesh për të vendosur të drejtën e pensionit në pension ose, ku zbatohet, me një shumë më të madhe pensioni të dhënë tashmë, sipas kushteve të vëna poshtë në këtë kapitull, deklaron Neni 7 i dekretit.
items.text_orig:
Spain’s Council of Ministers approved the inclusion of Romanian Orthodox clergy serving in the country in its General Social Security Scheme on 17 November. Romanian Orthodox priests will be treated as employees for social security purposes, on the basis of a certificate issued by the Romanian Orthodox Diocese of Spain and Portugal.

Romanian Orthodox clergy in Spain will therefore be entitled to retirement pensions, permanent disability pensions, death grants and survivors’ benefits.

Their social protection will be provided under Spain’s General Social Security Scheme, except for unemployment benefits.

An important aspect of the new regulation is that periods of clerical service preceding the recent approval of the royal decree concerning Romanian Orthodox clergy may also be recognised.

“Periods of activity carried out on Spanish territory as a minister of the Romanian Orthodox Church in Spain before the entry into force of this royal decree shall be recognised as contribution periods for the purpose of establishing entitlement to a retirement pension or, where applicable, to a higher amount of an already awarded retirement pension, under the conditions laid down in this chapter,” states Article 7 of the decree .

The legislative initiative dates back to 2023, and its recent approval concludes a process formally launched in 2019 in response to a request from the Romanian Orthodox community in Spain, according to the Spanish government’s official documents .

Photo credit: Lumina Newspaper

items.title_orig: Patriarch Daniel urges Christians to grow rich in God through gratitude and generosity
items.sum:
"Një person bëhet i pasur në Perëndinë nëpërmjet lutjeve të falënderimit, kur ata e falënderojnë Perëndinë për dhuratën e jetës dhe të shëndetit dhe për gjithë ndihmën që kanë marrë prej Tij, 190 Fortlumturia e Patriarku Tij Daniel tha të dielën në kapelën historike të Shën Xhorxh Martirit të Madh në Riparencën Patriarkale.

Fortlumturia e Tij theksoi nevojën për mirënjohje ndaj Perëndisë për dhuratat e marra dhe për bamirësi ndaj të tjerëve, duke reflektuar mbi leximin e Ungjillit të Lollit të Ri, toka e të cilit dha një korrje të bollshme.

Patriarku Daniel i inkurajoi besimtarët që të pasuroheshin në Perëndinë nëpërmjet lutjes dhe veprave të mira.

Nëpërmjet lutjes, si një marrëdhënie e gjallë mes njeriut dhe Perëndisë, Perëndia derdh dashuri në shpirtin e personit që lutet dhe bëhet një pasuri hire për gjithë përjetësinë.

Primate i Kishës Orthodhokse Rumune theksoi se një person pasurohet në Zot kur ndajnë me të tjerët dhuratat që kanë marrë nga Ai.

Nga ana tjetër, varfëria materiale, nëse nuk kthehet ose nuk transformohet në përpjekje për të pasuruar jetën frymore me anë të lutjes, të një jete të pastër dhe të ndershme, me shpresë te Perëndia, mund të sjellë shumë ligësi: zili, rebelim, urrejtje, vjedhje, korrupsion, dhunë, dëshpërim, rënie morale dhe çrregullim shoqëror, shtoi Patriarku Daniel.
items.text_orig:
“A person grows rich in God through prayers of thanksgiving, when they thank God for the gift of life and health and for all the help they have received from Him,” Fortlumturia e Tij Patriarch Daniel said on Sunday at the historic Chapel of St George the Great Martyr in the Patriarchal Residence.

Fortlumturia e Tij emphasised the need for gratitude towards God for the gifts received and for charity towards others, reflecting on the Gospel reading of the Rich Fool, whose land yielded an abundant harvest.

Patriarch Daniel encouraged the faithful to grow rich in God through prayer and good deeds.

“Through prayer, as a living relationship between the human person and God, God’s love pours into the soul of the person who prays and becomes a wealth of grace for eternity.”

God’s generosity

The Primate of the Romanian Orthodox Church emphasised that a person grows rich in God when they share with others the gifts they have received from Him.

“This is also the purpose of today’s Holy Gospel: to teach us that God’s generosity or mercy calls us to be generous and merciful in turn.”

Patriarch Daniel explained that generosity can take two forms: material, such as providing food and clothing, and spiritual.

“We show spiritual generosity when we pray for people’s health and salvation, when we offer someone a kind word, a sign that they have not been forgotten, encouragement in times of trouble, consolation in times of sorrow or wise advice in moments of uncertainty. All these are acts of merciful love expressed spiritually.”

“In contrast to charity, which brings joy to both the recipient and the giver, passionate or obsessive greed for increasing material wealth often brings unrest, hatred and quarrels among neighbours, friends and relatives, and sometimes lawsuits, fights and even murder,” Patriarch Daniel warned.

Wealth and poverty

Fortlumturia e Tij explained that neither material wealth nor poverty guarantees salvation. What matters is how people use their circumstances and resources.

“Unfortunately, throughout human history, many wars between nations have been driven primarily by greed for the conquest of new territories and the desire to dominate others. In this regard, Blessed Augustine says that greed for material possessions divides people, while merciful love brings them together.”

“On the other hand, material poverty, if it is not converted or transformed into an effort to enrich one’s spiritual life through prayer, a pure life and honest work, with hope in God, can also produce many evils: envy, rebellion, hatred, theft, corruption, violence, despair, moral decline and social disorder,” Patriarch Daniel added.

“Today’s Gospel sheds light on how wealth should be used: as a gift from God that the wealthy must share with the poor.”

The Church’s charitable work

The Patriarch recalled that, throughout the centuries, the Church has encouraged Christian emperors, kings, rulers and wealthy people to practise charity.

“In the Romanian Principalities, the first infirmaries or facilities for caring for the sick, homes for the elderly, orphanages and houses for pilgrims were organised by the Church, often with the support of wealthy and charitable Christians.”

“Although the vow of voluntary poverty is a spiritual rule for monks living in fraternal, communal or cenobitic communities, the Church does not preach poverty as an ideal for lay believers as well. Rather, it encourages all lay Christians, especially the wealthy, to practise charity and help the poor.”

Concluding his sermon, Patriarch Daniel said:

“Today’s Gospel encourages us to become richer in soul and spirit through faith, confession, Holy Communion and good deeds, uniting fasting with prayer and charity.”

Photo credit: BASILICA Archive

items.title: Archimandrite Dometie Trihenea, first Romanian abbot of Zografou Monastery, remembered 41 years after his repose
items.summary: Archimandrite Dometie Trihenea, the first Romanian monk to lead one of the 20 ruling monasteries on Mount Athos, reposed in the Lord 41 years ago. Born in 1909 in Tilișca, a village in the Mărginimea Sibiului region of Romania, he was left in the care of his grandparents after…
items.text:
Archimandrite Dometie Trihenea, the first Romanian monk to lead one of the 20 ruling monasteries on Mount Athos, reposed in the Lord 41 years ago.

Born in 1909 in Tilișca, a village in the Mărginimea Sibiului region of Romania, he was left in the care of his grandparents after his parents departed with their flocks for seasonal transhumance and could not return home because of the outbreak of the First World War.

At age 12, he experienced a vision in which the Mother of God guided him toward the monasteries of Mount Athos.

A year later, in 1922, he set out for the Holy Mountain with another young man, under the guidance of Hieromonk Diomid Velasa.

He settled at the Romanian Cell of St. Hypatius, under the jurisdiction of Vatopedi Monastery.

After seven years of monastic formation, he was tonsured a monk and received the name Dometie.

In 1937, he was ordained deacon and priest, and in 1964 he became a spiritual father.

First Romanian abbot of Zografou Monastery

Recognised for his spiritual life, Fr Dometie was appointed abbot of Zografou Monastery on 8 February 1965, becoming the first Romanian monk to hold this responsibility.

When he assumed leadership, the monastery faced administrative and financial difficulties, with only a small number of monks and numerous buildings in a state of disrepair.

During his nearly ten years as abbot, he worked to address the monastery’s administrative problems.

Alongside these responsibilities, he served for 15 years as a spiritual father at Konstamonitou Monastery, guiding Greek, Romanian, Bulgarian, Macedonian and Albanian monks.

A particularly significant moment in his ministry was his meeting with the late Patriarch Justinian Marina, who visited the Cell of St Hypatius on 27 June 1963 during his journey to Mount Athos for the celebrations marking the 1,000th anniversary of the founding of the Great Lavra.

In his notes about the visit, Archimandrite Dometie Trihenea recorded the Patriarch’s exhortation to the Romanian monks:

“May God and the Mother of God, the protectress of this Holy Mountain, be glorified through you and your deeds.”

A renowned spiritual father and healer

After completing his service as abbot of Zografou Monastery, he returned to the Cell of St Hypatius, where he continued to receive numerous pilgrims and monks.

He was known both for his spiritual discernment and for his knowledge of herbal medicine.

He gathered plants and prepared remedies from them for various illnesses.

Accounts from monks who knew him attribute to him the healing of conditions for which those suffering had found no relief through conventional treatments.

Archimandrite Dometie Trihenea reposed in the Lord on 20 November 1985.

Photo source: Lumina Newspaper

items.title_orig: Archbishop of Canada makes first Pastoral Visit to Greek Orthodox Community in Hamilton
items.sum:
Festa e Entances së Theocokos në tempull u festua me solemnitet të madh dhe pjesëmarrjen e besimtarëve të shumtë në Kishën Orthodhokse Greke të Panagisë në Hamilton, Kanada, e cila shënon 49 vjet shërbim për komunitetin lokal grek këtë vit.

Në rastin e festës, kryepeshkopi Apostolos i Kanadasë bëri vizitën e tij të parë baritore në famulli, ku prifti i famullisë, Fr.

Në darkën festive që pasoi, e ndjekur nga rreth 200 anëtarë të komunitetit dhe miq, lojtari i Hamilton Tiger-Katsonos paraqiti arqipeshkopin Apostolos me një fanetë përkujtimore që mban emrin EAPOSTOLOS dhe numrin e viteve të tij.

Kryepeshkopi i parë i vizitës baritore përfundoi me një shkëmbim përshëndetjesh dhe bisedash personale me besimtarët, duke forcuar më tej lidhjet midis kryepeshkopit të ri dhe komunitetit orthodhoks grek Hamilton.
items.text_orig:
The Feast of the Entrance of the Theotokos into the Temple was celebrated with great solemnity and the participation of numerous faithful at the Greek Orthodox Church of Panagia in Hamilton, Canada, which marks 49 years of service to the local Greek community this year.

On the occasion of the feast, Archbishop Apostolos of Canada made his first pastoral visit to the parish, where he was warmly welcomed by the parish priest, Fr. Elias Drosos, Community President Ioannis Nikolaos Mathioudakis, members of the Parish Council, and the faithful.

On the eve of the feast, Archbishop Apostolos presided over the Great Festal Vespers, attended by hundreds of worshippers. In his address, he reflected on the theological significance of the Entrance of the Theotokos into the Temple, emphasizing the role of the Virgin Mary in the mystery of Christ’s Incarnation.

He also congratulated the community for its longstanding contribution to preserving the Orthodox faith and Greek traditions in Canada.

During the visit, Fr. Elias Drosos presented the Archbishop with an episcopal epigonation depicting the Theotokos.

At the festive dinner that followed, attended by approximately 200 community members and friends, Hamilton Tiger-Cats player Stavros Katsantonis presented Archbishop Apostolos with a commemorative team jersey bearing the name “APOSTOLOS” and the number “26,” in honor of the year of his election.

On the feast day itself, Archbishop Apostolos presided over the festal Divine Liturgy in the presence of a large congregation.

A particularly significant moment was the tonsuring of new readers, whom the Archbishop encouraged to serve the Church with faith, humility, and dedication.

He also addressed the children and young people of the parish, urging them to maintain strong ties with the Church, the Greek language, and their cultural traditions.

The Archbishop’s first pastoral visit concluded with an exchange of greetings and personal conversations with the faithful, further strengthening the bonds between the new Archbishop and the Greek Orthodox community of Hamilton.

items.title: Metropolitan Antonie and Romanian Cultural Institute seek closer cooperation in Chișinău
items.summary: Metropolitan Antonie of Bessarabia visited the Mihai Eminescu Romanian Cultural Institute in Chișinău on 19 November at the invitation of its Director, Monica Babuc. The meeting focused on strengthening cooperation between the two institutions and developing joint initiatives to…
items.text:
Metropolitan Antonie of Bessarabia visited the Mihai Eminescu Romanian Cultural Institute in Chișinău on 19 November at the invitation of its Director, Monica Babuc.

The meeting focused on strengthening cooperation between the two institutions and developing joint initiatives to promote Romania’s spiritual, historical and cultural heritage in the Republic of Moldova.

Discussions highlighted the responsibility of Romanian institutions to coordinate their efforts and turn shared objectives into projects accessible to the widest possible audience.

Promoting books, raising awareness of prominent figures in Romanian culture and passing on the heritage of previous generations to young people were among the main topics discussed.

Church and culture

Metropolitan Antonie emphasised the profound connection between Church life and Romanian culture, recalling the contribution of clergy, theological schools and religious publications to the formation and preservation of national consciousness.

He explained that in Bessarabia, this relationship took on particular significance during periods of foreign domination and persecution, when the faith, language, and collective memory of local communities came under systematic pressure.

Preserving this heritage requires both knowledge and active cultivation, the Metropolitan added.

Helping young people engage with Romanian literature, history and spirituality requires continuity, guidance and institutions working together.

In this context, cooperation between the Metropolis of Bessarabia and the Romanian Cultural Institute could bring cultural resources closer to parish communities and encourage the faithful to participate in cultural life.

Joint cultural events

The meeting also explored opportunities to organise joint events dedicated to historical and spiritual heritage, promote books, and commemorate figures who have contributed to Romanian culture.

Monica Babuc welcomed Metropolitan Antonie’s visit and his openness towards the mission of the Mihai Eminescu Romanian Cultural Institute in Chișinău.

The Institute’s Director emphasised the importance of substantial cooperation with the Metropolis of Bessarabia to promote Romanian cultural and spiritual values in the Republic of Moldova.

At the conclusion of the meeting, Monica Babuc presented Metropolitan Antonie with several books of historical and cultural significance representing Romania’s heritage.

Photo credit: Metropolis of Bessarabia

items.title: IPS Varsanufie: Nu averea îl îmbogățește pe om înaintea lui Dumnezeu, ci iubirea prin care aceasta devine milostenie
items.summary: „Nu averea îl îmbogățește pe om înaintea lui Dumnezeu, ci iubirea prin care averea devine milostenie”, a subliniat duminică Arhiepiscopul Varsanufie al Râmnicului, în Parohia Voineasa din județul Vâlcea. Pornind de la Evanghelia Duminicii a 26-a după Rusalii, Înaltpreasfinția Sa…
items.text:
„Nu averea îl îmbogățește pe om înaintea lui Dumnezeu, ci iubirea prin care averea devine milostenie”, a subliniat duminică Arhiepiscopul Varsanufie al Râmnicului, în Parohia Voineasa din județul Vâlcea.

Pornind de la Evanghelia Duminicii a 26-a după Rusalii, Înaltpreasfinția Sa a explicat că „lumea l-a numit bogat pe cel care a adunat multe bunuri, care și-a umplut hambarele și și-a asigurat cele trebuincioase pentru mulți ani, însă Dumnezeu a privit dincolo de toate acestea și a văzut sărăcia sufletului celui nemilostiv”.

„Adevărata bogăție nu se măsoară prin ceea ce omul reușește să adune în jurul său, ci prin ceea ce primește de la Dumnezeu și lăsă să rodească în inima sa”.

În acest sens, arhiepiscopul a îndemnat la căutarea adevăratelor lucruri care îl îmbogățesc pe om, „prin rugăciune, smerenie, iertare, milostenie și toate virtuțile care îmbogățesc sufletul”.

„Cel care gustă bunătățile lui Dumnezeu nu mai poate trăi numai pentru sine, pentru că acestea nu pot fi închise într-o vistierie personală. Bunătatea este o lumină care trebuie să lumineze și alte suflete, o iubire care trebuie să se reverse în fapte”, a spus Înaltpreasfinția Sa.

Bogăția materială și sărăcia sufletească

Referindu-se la starea bogatului căruia i-a rodit țarina, Înaltpreasfințitul Părinte Varsanufie a subliniat că deși avea numeroase lucruri materiale, „nu a lăsat ca darurile primite să rodească în inima sa”: „El nu a văzut nimic în afara propriei persoane. Nu L-a pomenit pe Dumnezeu, nu l-a văzut pe aproapele, nu s-a gândit la cel lipsit”.

„Ceea ce nu a înțeles, de fapt, este că bunătatea dumnezeiască, revărsându-se asupra omului, îl cheamă și pe acesta la asemănarea cu Dăruitorul. Bogatul însă a primit bunătatea, dar nu s-a făcut bun”.

Arhiepiscopul Râmnicului a explicat că averea nu este rea în sine, ci modul în care aceasta este întrebuințată: „Bogăția, atunci când este însoțită de iubire și milostivire, poate deveni mijloc de mântuire; însă, atunci când este stăpânită de egoism, se transformă în pricină de înstrăinare de Dumnezeu”.

„Dumnezeu nu i-a luat bogatului nici țarina, nici roadele, nici hambarele. Nu i-a risipit averea și nu l-a lipsit de bunurile pe care le dobândise. I-a cerut sufletul, arătându-i că toate bogățiile pământești nu-i puteau prelungi viața”, a mai spus Înaltpreasfinția Sa.

„Să ne dăruiască Dumnezeu înțelepciunea de a nu amâna binele, puterea de a împărtăși ceea ce am primit și dragostea de a transforma fiecare zi într-un prilej de manifestare a bunătății, pentru a ne îmbogăți în lumina vieții veșnice”, a spus la final Înaltpreasfințitul Părinte Varsanufie.

Foto credit: Arhiepiscopia Râmnicului

items.title_orig: Twenty years since the repose of Fr Gheorghe Calciu, a voice of resistance to communism
items.sum:
E shtunë, 21 nëntor, shënoi 20 vjet që nga pushimi i Pr George Calciu-Dumistreasa, një prift orthodhoks rumun që duroi burgimin komunist dhe u bë një zë i shquar i rezistencës shpirtërore ndaj regjimit.

Fror George Calciu-Dumitreasa lindi në 1925 në Mahmudia, në deltën e Danubit, Rumani.

I dënuar me tetë vjet burg, ai u transferua në Piteti gjatë lartësisë së regjimit komunist, programi famëkeq i edukimit.

Beteja e fundit ishte në zemrat tona, pasi ne kishim shpëtuar nga Pitahiti. Dhe për shumicën prej nesh, në zemrat e shumicës, ajo betejë e fundit u fitua nga Zoti, (f. Grorghe Calciu) kujton.

Ai mbeti nën mbikqyrje të vazhdueshme nga Sekuritate, Rumania, policia e fshehtë komuniste, por refuzoi të bashkëpunojë me të.

Kalçiu u bë një nga zërat kryesorë të rezistencës shpirtërore ndaj regjimit komunist.

Më 10 mars 1979, ai u arrestua dhe u dënua me dhjetë vjet burgim me pretekstin se ishte përfshirë në Bashkimin e Tregtisë së Lirë të Popullit të Punës të Rumanisë.

Shkarkimi i tij, i vendosur nga kisha orthodhokse rumune në 1984, u hoq dhjetë vjet më pas.

Për të nderuar kujtesën dhe flijimin e atyre që dhanë dëshmi për besimin e tyre në burgjet komuniste, Sinodi i Shenjtë i Kishës Orthodhokse Rumune shpalli vitin 2025 Vitin Kommorues të Etërve Shpirtërorë Rumunë dhe Rrëfyesit e Shekullit të 20-të.
items.text_orig:
Saturday, 21 November, marked 20 years since the repose of Fr Gheorghe Calciu-Dumitreasa, a Romanian Orthodox priest who endured communist imprisonment and became a prominent voice of spiritual resistance to the regime.

Fr Gheorghe Calciu-Dumitreasa was born in 1925 in Mahmudia, in the Danube Delta, Romania. He was the eleventh and youngest child of a devout farming family.

He attended Spiru Haret High School in Tulcea before enrolling in the Faculty of Medicine in Bucharest.

Subjected to re-education at Pitești

In 1948, he was accused of printing anti-communist leaflets and supporting leaders of the nationalist student movement. Sentenced to eight years in prison, he was transferred to Pitești during the height of the communist regime’s notorious “re-education” programme.

“I believe that, many times, because of terror and fear, our hearts allowed the devil to prevail. But in the end, God brought each of us back. He gave each of us the chance to fight the final battle. For the final battle was not at Pitești. The final battle was in our hearts, after we had escaped Pitești. And for most of us, in the hearts of most, that final battle was won by God,” Fr Gheorghe Calciu recalled.

Over time, he nevertheless began to recover from his ordeal. In 1955, he refused to give the false testimony demanded by investigators, who sought to blame the prisoners themselves for the abuses committed during the re-education programme.

Resistance to communism

Released in 1963, he was placed under compulsory residence in Viișoara.

He remained under constant surveillance by the Securitate, Romania’s communist secret police, but refused to collaborate with it.

In 1967, he obtained a degree in Philology. With the support of Patriarch Justinian, he subsequently studied theology and was ordained to the priesthood, fulfilling a promise he had made while imprisoned.

During the 1970s, Fr. Calciu became one of the leading voices of spiritual resistance to the communist regime.

In his series of sermons entitled Words to Young People, published in 1978, he publicly denounced the demolition of churches and the prevailing climate of oppression, provoking a harsh response from the authorities.

He was dismissed from his teaching position at the Theological Seminary, while the Securitate harassed his family.

On 10 March 1979, he was arrested and sentenced to ten years in prison on the pretext that he was involved in the Free Trade Union of the Working People of Romania.

He was confined to a psychiatric institution and subsequently transferred to Aiud Prison, where he was placed in a cell with common-law prisoners who were reportedly instructed to kill him.

After speaking with Fr Calciu, however, the prisoners refused to carry out the assassination plan.

Received at the White House

International pressure from Ronald Reagan, Margaret Thatcher and Pope John Paul II contributed to his release in 1984.

In 1985, he was forced to leave Romania with his family.

His defrocking, imposed by the Romanian Orthodox Church in 1984, was lifted ten years later.

After arriving in the United States, he initially worked as an unskilled labourer before becoming the priest of an Orthodox parish in Washington.

He was received at the White House by both Ronald Reagan and George H. W. Bush.

Following the Romanian Revolution of 1989, he frequently returned to Romania.

Fr Gheorghe Calciu-Dumitreasa reposed in the Lord on 21 November 2006 and was buried at Petru Vodă Monastery in Neamț County.

To honour the memory and sacrifice of those who bore witness to their faith in communist prisons, the Holy Synod of the Romanian Orthodox Church proclaimed 2025 the “Commemorative Year of Romanian Orthodox Spiritual Fathers and Confessors of the 20th Century”.

Photo source: gheorghecalciu.ro

items.title: Kryepeshkopi i Amerikës bekon ikona të rralla në katedralen e Vikaritjes sllave
items.summary: Archbishop Elpidophoros of America consecrated the iconostasis of Saint Matrona of Moscow Cathedral in Miami on Sunday, Nov. 22. Built from several thousand pieces of hand-gilded ceramic, it is the only faience iconostasis in the United States and the first in North America…
items.ex: Kryepeshkopi Elpidoforos i Amerikës shenjtëroi të dielën, Nov 22. I ndërtuar nga disa mijëra copa qeramike të komanduara me dorë, është i vetmi portret i faioztas në Shtetet e Bashkuara dhe i pari në Amerikën e Veriut
items.title_orig: Archbishop of America blesses rare iconostasis at Slavic Vicariate cathedral
items.sum:
Kryepeshkopi Elpidophos i Amerikës shenjtëroi portretostazën e Katedrales së Shën Matronës së Moskës në Majami të dielën, Nov. I ndërtuar nga disa mijëra copa qeramike të komanduara me dorë, është i vetmi ikonë faioztas në Shtetet e Bashkuara dhe i pari në Amerikën e Veriut, sipas katedrales.

Ati Oleksandr, Zoti ju bekoftë me mençuri dhe me çdo hir, ndërsa vazhdoni këtë vepër për të edukuar besimtarët dhe për të forcuar unitetin e këtij Vicariati, tha kryepeshkopi.

Bishop Aleksandri tani shërben si një peshkop i Auxiliar i fronit ekumenik në Metropolisin e Shenjtë të Buenos Aires dhe Amerikës së Jugut. Shërbimi i së dielës ishte vizita e tij e parë në katedrale që kur ishte caktuar.

I njëjti kujtim për adhurimin e ikonave, kryepeshkopi tha: " Kur puthim një ikonë, nuk adhurojmë materialin e saj.

Dua që secili nga ju të kujtojë se Kisha është një vend ku vuajtjet janë të mirëpritura, ku të lodhurit gjejnë ngushëllim, dhe ku çdo shpirt mund të arrijë mëshirën e Krishtit, tha Hiria e Tij.

Duke kërkuar një material që do të zgjaste për breza të tërë, peshkopi Aleksandër, pastaj rektori i katedrales, propozoi faience, një qeramikë të mirë e të qëndrueshme, e quajtur nga Faenza, qyteti italian i famshëm për qeramikën e tij.

I vetmi në Amerikë qëndron në Buenos Aires, Argjentinë, ku u soll nga Rusia Perandorake më shumë se një shekull më parë, sipas katedrales.

Ngjyrat kanë domethënie, thotë katedraleja: e bardhë për pastërti, ar për dritën e Mbretërisë së qiellit dhe jeshile e butë për jetën frymore dhe për Shën Matronën, shenjtorin mbrojtës të katedrales.

Ivan Belja, themeluesi i katedrales dhe Drejtori i Marrëdhënieve Publike të Vikariatit Sllav të Arkidioqezës Orthodhokse Greke të Amerikës.
items.text_orig:
Archbishop Elpidophoros of America consecrated the iconostasis of Saint Matrona of Moscow Cathedral in Miami on Sunday, Nov. 22. Built from several thousand pieces of hand-gilded ceramic, it is the only faience iconostasis in the United States and the first in North America, according to the cathedral.

During the Divine Liturgy, the Archbishop announced that the Archdiocese’s Holy Eparchial Synod, at an extraordinary meeting on Thursday, Nov. 19, appointed the Rev. Oleksandr Belya as Vicar of the Slavic Vicariate. The Rev. Oleksandr Belya succeeds his son, Bishop Alexander of Nicopolis, who led the Vicariate until his ordination to the episcopacy on Nov. 15. “There is something particularly beautiful in this transition, for the father now follows in the footsteps of his son!” the Archbishop said.

“Father Oleksandr, may the Lord bless you with wisdom and every grace as you continue this work of nurturing the faithful and strengthening the unity of this Vicariate,” the Archbishop said.

South Florida is home to an estimated 200,000 Americans with roots in Ukraine, Russia, Belarus, Moldova, Georgia and elsewhere in Eastern Europe, according to the cathedral.

Bishop Alexander now serves as an Auxiliary Bishop of the Ecumenical Throne in the Holy Metropolis of Buenos Aires and South America. Sunday’s service was his first visit to the cathedral since his ordination. The Archbishop thanked him for his years as Vicar.

The consecration followed the Divine Liturgy for the Seventh Sunday of Luke.

In his homily, the Archbishop turned to the day’s Gospel reading, in which a woman who had suffered for 12 years reaches through a crowd to touch the hem of Christ’s robe and is healed. “But it was not the fabric of His garment that healed her,” the Archbishop said. “It was the Divine Grace of Christ, received through her extraordinary faith.”

The same holds for the veneration of icons, the Archbishop said: “When we kiss an icon, we do not worship its material. We offer our love and veneration to the person represented.”

The Archbishop told the faithful that the Lord knows the burdens they carry, even those no one else can see. “I want every one of you to remember that the Church is a place where the suffering are welcomed, where the weary find consolation, and where every soul can reach out toward the mercy of Christ,” Hirësia e Tij said.

The iconostasis, the wall of icons that stands before the altar in an Orthodox church, spans 44.5 feet and rises 19.2 feet, nearly two stories, across the front of the cathedral. Set into its white, gold and soft green ceramic are 32 icons painted by iconographers of the Kyiv Pechersk Lavra. The work took seven years.

“And this is the true beauty of your newly blessed Iconostasis. It reminds us that heaven is not distant from earth, that the Saints are not strangers to us, and that the Lord Who healed the suffering woman is the very same Lord Who remains present in His Church today.” Archbishop Elpidophoros

Most iconostases are made of wood, but in South Florida’s heat and humidity, wood needs constant protection from moisture and termites. Looking for a material that would last for generations, Bishop Alexander, then the cathedral’s rector, proposed faience, a durable fine ceramic named after Faenza, the Italian town famous for its pottery.

Faience iconostases first appeared in the Russian Empire in the late 19th century, and only a few survive. The only other one in the Americas stands in Buenos Aires, Argentina, where it was brought from Imperial Russia more than a century ago, according to the cathedral.

Artisans shaped, fired, glazed and gilded each piece by hand, and installing them in the cathedral took several months. The colors carry meaning, the cathedral says: white for purity, gold for the light of the Kingdom of Heaven, and soft green for spiritual life and for Saint Matrona, the cathedral’s patron saint.

The project was carried out by Dr. Ivan Belya, the cathedral’s founder and Director of Public Relations of the Slavic Vicariate of the Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of America. Dr. Belya, a Doctor of Theology, was invested as Archon Chartoularios of the Ecumenical Patriarchate on Oct. 18. He has founded five churches in America and has received the Medal of St. Paul, the highest honor the Archdiocese bestows on lay people.

The parish began in 2011 in a small rented space in Hallandale Beach. In 2015, it purchased the historic church on South Federal Highway in Dania Beach, a site of worship since 1903. The cathedral seats up to 800 and, according to the parish, draws more than 7,000 people over the two days of Pascha.

items.title_orig: Romanian Orthodox cathedral in Madrid marks patronal feast: Every person is called to be God’s dwelling place
items.sum:
Katedralja orthodhokse rumune e hyrjes së Nënës së Perëndisë në tempull në Madrid festoi festën e saj mbrojtëse të shtunën. Peshkopi Timotei nga Spanja dhe Portugalia festoi Liturgjinë Hyjnore me ndihmës peshkopin e tij Teofil të Iberisë.

Ata që ndoqën shërbimin përfshinin Kristina-Lavinia Arnáutu, një drejtore që ushtron përgjegjësitë e një sekretari shteti në Departamentin e Rumanisë për Rumunët jashtë; Raluca Maria Mihnzil, Chargée dʼAffairs adkocent në Ambasadën Rumune në Mbretërinë e Spanjës; konsulla Loredana Florea; Gabriela Tunase, një përfaqësuese e Ministrisë së Ekonomisë, Dizabilitetit, Turizmit dhe përfaqësuesve të tjerë të ambasadës rumune.

Peshkopi Timotei nga Spanja dhe Portugalia falenderoi gjithashtu Hirian e Tij Metropolitan Besarion, metropolitan orthodhoks grek i Spanjës dhe Portugalisë dhe Eparkun e Detit Mesdhe (Patrika ekumenik), për pjesëmarrjen në festën mbrojtëse të Katedrales Episkole në Madrid.
items.text_orig:
The Romanian Orthodox Diocesan Cathedral of the Entry of the Mother of God into the Temple in Madrid celebrated its patronal feast on Saturday. Bishop Timotei of Spain and Portugal celebrated the Divine Liturgy with his Assistant Bishop, Teofil of Iberia.

Those attending the service included Cristina-Lavinia Arnăutu, a director exercising the responsibilities of a secretary of state at Romania’s Department for Romanians Abroad; Raluca Maria Mihăilă, Chargée d’Affaires ad interim at the Romanian Embassy in the Kingdom of Spain; Consul Loredana Florea; Gabriela Tănase, a representative of Romania’s Ministry of Economy, Digitalisation, Entrepreneurship and Tourism; and other representatives of the Romanian Embassy and Consulate.

Assistant Bishop Teofil of Iberia emphasised that “every human being is called to become a living dwelling place of God. He wishes to dwell in our hearts, to find rest there, just as He dwelt and found rest in the heart of the Most Holy Virgin Mary.”

“More than anything, the Lord desires to be born in our hearts. Not only at the feast of the Nativity of the Lord, but always, day after day, at every Divine Liturgy, we must be ready to receive the Lord into our hearts,” Hirësia e Tij added.

During the Divine Liturgy, Bishop Timotei ordained Deacon Cristian Gheorghiță Sacaliuc to the priesthood for the Parish of St Matthew the Apostle and Evangelist – Valencia II.

Romania does not end at the country’s borders

At the conclusion of the service, Bishop Timotei presented distinctions to several benefactors in recognition of their involvement and support for the Church.

Cristina-Lavinia Arnăutu received the Episcopal Cross for her support of the diocese and the Romanian community.

“Romania does not end at the country’s borders. Romania is wherever Romanians are, wherever the Romanian language is spoken, and wherever faith, traditions and love for one’s country are kept alive. This cathedral is living proof of the faith and strength of a community that, far from home, has not forgotten its roots. It is a place where Romanians meet, rediscover their sense of belonging and keep their connection with Romania alive,” Cristina-Lavinia Arnăutu emphasised in a Facebook post .

“Attending the patronal feast of the cathedral in Madrid was a deeply moving and joyful experience. Among the Romanian community, I felt at home. I thank everyone for their warm welcome and for the emotion of this encounter. Wherever they may be, Romania must remain close to them,” Cristina-Lavinia Arnăutu added.

Bishop Timotei of Spain and Portugal also thanked Hirësia e Tij Metropolitan Bessarion, Greek Orthodox Metropolitan of Spain and Portugal and Exarch of the Mediterranean Sea (Ecumenical Patriarchate), for attending the patronal feast of the Episcopal Cathedral in Madrid.

Photo credit: Diocese of Spain and Portugal

items.title_orig: Romanian Orthodox parish in Belfast marks patronal feast with bishops and carol concert
items.sum:
famullia orthodhokse rumune në Belfast, Irlanda e Veriut festoi festën e saj mbrojtëse të shtunën, hyrjen e Nënës së Perëndisë në tempull, me lutjet dhe një koncert të këngëve të Krishtlindjeve.

Kryepeshkopi Atanasi i Britanisë së Madhe dhe i Irlandës së Veriut festuan Liturgjinë Hyjnore, bashkë me peshkopin Nektari të Irlandës dhe Islandës.

Kryepeshkopi Atanasi theksoi se festa e hyrjes së Nënës së Perëndisë në tempull zbulon një thirrje drejtuar çdo të krishteri: të bëhet një tempull i Perëndisë së gjallë.

Parisi orthodhoks rumun i hyrjes së Nënës së Perëndisë në tempull në Belfast ka një histori të lidhur ngushtë me festën e tij mbrojtëse.
items.text_orig:
The Romanian Orthodox parish in Belfast, Northern Ireland, celebrated its patronal feast on Saturday, the Entry of the Mother of God into the Temple, with prayers and a concert of Christmas carols.

Archbishop Atanasie of Great Britain and Northern Ireland celebrated the Divine Liturgy, together with Bishop Nectarie of Ireland and Iceland.

Archbishop Atanasie emphasised that the feast of the Entry of the Mother of God into the Temple reveals a calling addressed to every Christian: to become a temple of the living God.

The Archbishop also encouraged the faithful to follow the example of the Most Holy Virgin Mary, who, through obedience, humility and purity of heart, became a dwelling place of God.

Parish celebrations

Aurelia Nicoleta Titirez, Consul and Coordinator of Romania’s Consular Office in Belfast, attended the service.

She expressed appreciation for the parish’s pastoral and community activities, highlighting the Church’s role in preserving the Orthodox faith and Romanian identity in Northern Ireland.

The parish priest, Fr. Romeo Toma Puiu, thanked the two hierarchs for celebrating the Divine Liturgy.

The parish celebrations continued with a concert of Christmas carols performed by the Nepsis Choir from Dublin, followed by a fellowship meal.

The Romanian Orthodox Parish of the Entry of the Mother of God into the Temple in Belfast has a history closely connected to its patron feast.

The Romanian Orthodox mission began on 21 November 2007, when the first service in Romanian was celebrated for a small group of faithful, including teachers, students, doctoral researchers and workers who had settled in Northern Ireland.

Photo credit: ROARCH

items.text:
Pr. Răzvan Ionescu a început cu o slujbă de binecuvântare lucrările care aşează temelia noului centru cultural și cultual al românilor din regiunea pariziană de la Ivry.

Locul se află în apropierea stației Mairie d’Ivry de pe Linia 7 a metroului parizian, iar lucrările au început luni, a anunțat Părintele Răzvan Ionescu, prodecanul Centrului Ortodox de Studii și Cercetări „Dumitru Stăniloae” (CDS) al Mitropoliei Ortodoxe Române a Europei Occidentale și Meridionale.

Prima etapă a lucrărilor va include construirea subsolului între cota –5 și zero. Pereții vor fi construiți prin tehnica betonului împroșcat (torcretat), a transmis parohul pentru Basilica.ro .

Centrul va fi pus sub ocrotirea Sf. Cuv. Parascheva și a Sf. Cuv. Genoveva, Ocrotitoarea Parisului. Va include capelă, spațiu multifuncțional și cel puțin două săli de clasă pentru activitățile educaționale cu copiii din comunitatea românească.

Clericul a dezvăluit că proiectul este pregătit de comunitate de aproximativ două decenii, dar nu va putea fi realizat fără sprijinul donatorilor.

„Locul acesta îl veți putea vizita la Paris, veți ști că o cărămidă sau mai mult ați pus-o dumneavoastră”, a subliniat Părintele Răzvan Ionescu.

items.title_orig: Bulgarian Church Representative to Patriarch Kirill: “The Russian people are our brothers”
items.sum:
Njerëzit rusë janë vëllezërit tanë, i tha peshkopit Isak të Velbazhdit patriarkut Kiril të Moskës, i cili mori një delegacion të Kishës Orthodhokse Bullgare të dielën, më 22 nëntor 2026, në sallën e Ashonjës së Katedrales së Krishtit Shpëtimtarit në Moskë, si pjesë e festimeve që shënonin 80 vjetorin e tij.

Gjatë takimit, peshkopi Isak lexoi një mesazh përçmues nga patriarku Daniel i Bullgarisë, duke përcjellë përshëndetjet e Sinodit të Shenjtë të Kishës Orthodhokse Bullgare.

Në emër të patriarkut Daniel, peshkopi Isak i paraqiti patriarkut Kirill një dhuratë përkujtimore të përbërë nga një kryq dhe dy panagia.

Ai i kërkoi delegacionit bullgar t'i përçojë mirënjohjen e tij patriarkut Daniel për urimet dhe dëshirat e tij të ngrohta, duke shprehur vlerësimin e tij për ministrinë bullgare të patriarkëve.

Patriarku Kirill vlerësoi në mënyrë të veçantë përpjekjet e patriarkut Daniel 190 jo vetëm për përfitimin e kishës orthodhokse bullgare dhe besimin e saj, por gjithashtu për forcimin e marrëdhënieve ndër-orthodhoks.

Si një gjest vlerësimi, patriarku Kirill paraqiti një sërë panagiash dhe një kryq zgjedhor që do t'i dorëzohet patriarkut Daniel.
items.text_orig:
“The Russian people are our brothers,” told Bishop Isaac of Velbazhd to Patriarch Kirill of Moscow, who received a delegation of the Bulgarian Orthodox Church on Sunday, November 22, 2026, at the Throne Hall of the Cathedral of Christ the Saviour in Moscow, as part of the celebrations marking his 80th birthday.

The Bulgarian delegation consisted of Bishop Isaac of Velbazhd and Mikhail Taskov, who traveled to the Russian capital to participate in the anniversary celebrations.

Also attending the meeting was Metropolitan Anthony of Volokolamsk, Chairman of the Moscow Patriarchate’s Department for External Church Relations.

During the meeting, Bishop Isaac read a congratulatory message from Patriarch Daniel of Bulgaria, conveying the greetings of the Holy Synod of the Bulgarian Orthodox Church.

“With brotherly love in Christ our Saviour, on behalf of the Holy Synod of the Bulgarian Orthodox Church and on my own behalf, we warmly congratulate you on the occasion of your God-blessed 80th birthday,” Patriarch Daniel stated.

The Bulgarian Patriarch emphasized the longstanding spiritual ties between the two Churches, describing them as bonds of peace, love, mutual support, and cooperation that have endured for centuries.

He also praised Patriarch Kirill’s ecclesiastical ministry, recalling his service as a theologian, preacher, bishop, metropolitan, and Chairman of the Department for External Church Relations, as well as his contribution to dialogue among Christians.

Referring to the challenges currently facing Orthodoxy, Patriarch Daniel expressed his hope that Patriarch Kirill would continue guiding his flock with pastoral wisdom, apostolic zeal, and dedication to the proclamation of the Gospel.

On behalf of Patriarch Daniel, Bishop Isaac presented Patriarch Kirill with a commemorative gift consisting of a cross and two panagias.

“Pray for us, for our Church, our Patriarch, our clergy, and our faithful,” Bishop Isaac said. “You know that we love you and your flock. The Russian people are our brotherly people, and our ties date back to the time of Saints Cyril and Methodius. May God grant that these bonds remain strong in the future.”

Responding, Patriarch Kirill stressed that the spiritual ties between the Russian and Bulgarian Orthodox Churches had been strengthened over the centuries through prayer, spiritual life, and the blood of martyrs.

He asked the Bulgarian delegation to convey his gratitude to Patriarch Daniel for his congratulations and warm wishes, expressing his appreciation for the Bulgarian Patriarch’s ministry.

Patriarch Kirill particularly praised Patriarch Daniel’s efforts not only for the benefit of the Bulgarian Orthodox Church and its faithful but also for strengthening inter-Orthodox relations.

As a gesture of appreciation, Patriarch Kirill presented a set of panagias and a pectoral cross to be delivered to Patriarch Daniel. He also offered a panagia to Bishop Isaac and a commemorative gift to Mikhail Taskov.

At the conclusion of the meeting, Archpriest Vladimir Tyshchuk presented Patriarch Kirill with an Athonite-style icon of Saint Prince Vladimir as an additional commemorative gift.

items.title: Patriarku Daniel kryesoi liturgjinë për festën e katedrales në Sofje
items.summary: Patriarku bullgar foli para gazetarëve për humbjen e rëndë të Kishës dhe për rëndësinë e festës së Shën Aleksandër Nevskit.
items.text:
Patriarku bullgar Daniel dhe Mitropoliti i Sofjes kryesoi liturgjinë solemne patriarkale në katedralen "Shën Aleksandër Nevski" në Sofje. Sipas bg-patriarshia.bg, rasti ishte festa kryesore e tempullit, dita e Shenjtit Aleksandër Nevski, princ i bekuar.Para shërbesës, gazetarët e pritën Patriarkun Daniil në hyrje të faltores. Para tyre ai foli sërish për humbjen e rëndë që po përjeton Kisha Ortodokse Bullgare dhe kujtoi rëndësinë e kësaj feste.

Për këtë temë Patriarkana Bullgare kremtoi festën e Shën Aleksandër Nevskit

"Para së gjithash, sot është festa e katedrales sonë patriarkale. Është një festë që për më shumë se 100 vjet ka qenë e rëndësishme për gjithë Kishën tonë dhe në të vërtetë shohim se si në jetën e Kishës ndërthuren gëzimi dhe pikëllimi", tha Patriarku.Ai shtoi se kjo festë ka mbledhur gjithmonë Sinodin e Shenjtë në këtë vend. Sipas tij, ajo shpreh njëkohësisht unitetin e Kishës së shenjtë dhe mirënjohjen ndaj ushtarëve çlirimtarë rusë e ndaj Shën Aleksandër Nevskit.UGO kishte raportuar mbi qëndrimin e Kishës Ortodokse Bullgare ndaj "Sofia Pride 2026" më parë.

items.title: Mitropoliti Onufër kryesoi kremtimin e kishës “Shpejt-Dëgjueses” në Kiev
items.summary: Mbreti i Kishës Ortodokse Ukrainase drejtoi Liturgjinë Hyjnore në kompleksin kishtar kushtuar ikonës së Shën Mërisë
items.text: Më 22 nëntor 2026, Hirësia e Tij Mitropoliti i Kievit dhe i gjithë Ukrainës, Onufër, kryesoi Liturgjinë Hyjnore në kompleksin kishtar kushtuar ikonës së Shën Mërisë "Shpejt-Dëgjueses" në Kiev, me rastin e festës së titullit të kishës. Për këtë njofton faqja zyrtare e Kishës Ortodokse Ukrainase.Në shërbesën hyjnore me Mitropolitin Onufër bashkëshërbyen: kryetari i Departamentit Informativ-Edukativ të Kishës Ortodokse Ukrainase, mitropoliti i Nizhinit dhe Priluki-s, Kliment; mitropoliti i Vasilkivit, Joasaf; kryepeshkopët e Belgorodit, Sillvestri, i Pereiaslav-Hmelnytskyt, Dionisi, i Irpenit, Lavr, i Borodjankës, Mark, i Konstantinivkës, Paisi; peshkopët e Hostomelit, Arkadi, dhe i Borovskut, Kliment, si dhe kleri i kompleksit kishtar dhe mysafirë me rang të shenjtë.Gjatë hyrjes së vogël, Mitropoliti e nderoi diakonin e kishës, atë Igor, me dyfishin oraron. Në fund të shërbesës hyjnore, Mitropoliti Onufër përgëzoi besimtarët për festën dhe u dorëzoi shpërblime kishtare të pranishmëve.Më parë, SPZh shkroi se Mitropoliti Onufër kryesoi festën e titullit në Manastirin e Mbrojtjes së Shën Mërisë në Kiev.

items.title: Patriarku i Jerusalemit shënon 21-vjetorin e fronëzimit
items.summary: Në Katholikonë e Kishës së Varrit të Shenjtë u zhvillua një shërbesë solemne me rastin e jubileut të Patriarkut Theofil III
items.text: Në Katholikonë (Kishën Qëndrore) e Kishës së Varrit të Shenjtë në Jerusalem u zhvillua një shërbesë hyjnore solemne me rastin e 21-vjetorit të zgjedhjes dhe fronëzimit të Patriarkut të Jerusalemit dhe të gjithë Palestinës, Theofil III ashtu si na njofton Patriarkana e Jerusalemit.Në shërbesë morën pjesë anëtarë të Sinodit të Shenjtë të Kishës Orthodhokse të Jerusalemit, hierarkë, vëllazëria e Vëllazërisë së Varrit të Shenjtë dhe një numër i madh klerikësh. Në festime ishin të pranishëm ministri i Shëndetësisë së Greqisë, Adonis Georgiadis, ambasadorë të shteteve të huaja, si dhe përfaqësues të Kishave Orthodhokse Vendore.Në fjalën e tij të rastit, Patriarku Theofil III u bëri thirrje Kishave Orthodhokse Vendore të kapërcejnë përçarjet dhe të ruajnë unitetin eukaristik. "Ja, erdhi përsëri koha për t'i dhënë fund mosmarrëveshjeve dhe ndarjeve mes Kishave tona motra, që të jenë bërë një", theksoi Kryetari i Kishës së Jerusalemit.Patriarku gjithashtu theksoi rëndësinë e mbrojtjes së pranisë së krishterë në Tokën e Shenjtë dhe ruajtjen e status quo-s historike të Vendeve të Shenjta, në kushtet e konflikteve ushtarake që vazhdojnë në rajon.Pas lutjes, në ndërtesën e Patriarkanës së Jerusalemit u zhvillua një pritje zyrtare, gjatë së cilës Sekretari i Përgjithshëm, Kryepeshkopi i Konstantinës, Aristarh, në emër të Sinodit dhe vëllazërisë, uroi Kryetarin për përvjetorin e shërbimit të tij parësipëror.Më parë UGO shkroi se Patriarku i Jerusalemit njoftoi për planet për të vizituar Ukrainën.

items.title: Paraclisul viitorului Centru Eparhial al Episcopiei Daciei Felix a fost sfințit
items.summary: Paraclisul viitorului Centru Eparhial al Episcopiei Daciei Felix a fost sfințit sâmbătă de Preasfințitul Părinte Ieronim, Episcopul Daciei Felix, împreună cu Preasfințitul Părinte Maxim Danubianul, Arhiereul vicar al Episcopiei Italiei. Preasfințitul Părinte Ieronim a evidențiat…
items.text:
Paraclisul viitorului Centru Eparhial al Episcopiei Daciei Felix a fost sfințit sâmbătă de Preasfințitul Părinte Ieronim, Episcopul Daciei Felix, împreună cu Preasfințitul Părinte Maxim Danubianul, Arhiereul vicar al Episcopiei Italiei.

Preasfințitul Părinte Ieronim a evidențiat semnificația duhovnicească a momentului, subliniind că edificarea viitorului sediu administrativ al Episcopiei Daciei Felix a început prin construirea unui spațiu destinat rugăciunii.

„M-am gândit că este voia lui Dumnezeu ca să începem această lucrare a edificării și a frumusețării centrului eparhial printr-o lucrare sfântă”.

Episcopul Daciei Felix a explicat că această alegere exprimă prioritatea acordată vieții liturgice, care constituie temelia întregii activități pastorale, misionare și administrative a Bisericii.

Biserica și păstrarea identității românești

Preasfințitul Părinte Maxim Danubianul a evidențiat în predică semnificația praznicului Intrării Maicii Domnului în Biserică, explicând că aducerea Fecioarei Maria la Templul din Ierusalim a pregătit taina Întrupării Fiului lui Dumnezeu.

Totodată, Preasfinția Sa a vorbit despre dificultățile păstrării identității românești în diaspora, pornind de la experiența comunităților ortodoxe din Italia.

Ierarhul a arătat „cât de greu este câteodată să păstrezi tradiția românească”, în special pentru copiii și tinerii născuți în afara granițelor țării, care caută să își cunoască originile.

„De cele mai multe ori, Biserica vine și arată unde sunt rădăcinile, unde este casa”, a subliniat Preasfințitul Părinte Maxim Danubianul.

Aniversarea Episcopului Ieronim

La manifestare au participat reprezentanți ai autorităților centrale și locale, între care și Anca Corfu, consulul general al României la Vârșeț. Excelența Sa a fost felicitată de ierarh pentru sprijinul acordat activităților Episcopiei Daciei Felix.

Sărbătoarea sfințirii paraclisului a coincis cu aniversarea a 67 de ani de viață ai Preasfințitului Părinte Ieronim. Cu acest prilej, consulul general al României la Vârșeț i-a oferit episcopului un aranjament floral și i-a transmis un mesaj de felicitare.

„Transmitem calde urări de sănătate, bucurie, putere și multe, multe realizări în cadrul episcopiei Daciei Felix”, a spus consulul Anca Corfu pentru Trinitas TV .

Noul paraclis eparhial are trei hramuri: „Sfântul Ioan Botezătorul”, „Soborul Sfinților Arhangheli Mihail și Gavriil” și „Sfântul Ierarh Niceta de Remesiana”.

items.title: Bostoni nderon Atë Jani Trebickën në 35-vjetorin e hirotonisjes si prift
items.summary: Katedralja Orthodhokse Shqiptare e Shën Gjergjit shënoi me urime e mirënjohje rrugëtimin priftëror të Protopresviter Jani Trebickës
items.text: Komuniteti i Katedrales Orthodhokse Shqiptare të Shën Gjergjit në Boston shënoi 35-vjetorin e hirotonisjes në prift të Protopresviter Jani Trebicka, duke i shprehur dashurinë dhe mirënjohjen për praninë dhe shërbesën e tij në familjen kishtare.Në njoftimin e publikuar në faqen e saj në Facebook, katedralja përcolli urimin: «Jemi të bekuar që e kemi pjesë të familjes sonë! Për shumë vjet!». Pamjet që shoqërojnë postimin sjellin çaste nga një takim vëllazëror rreth tryezës, me Atë Janin mes pjesëtarëve të komunitetit.Ky përvjetor lidhet edhe me vitet e para të ringritjes së Kishës Orthodhokse në Shqipëri. Atë Jani u hirotonis dhjak më 28 korrik 1991 në Korçë, nga Kryepiskopi i lumur Anastas, atëherë Eksark i Patriarkanës Ekumenike. Më 24 nëntor të po atij viti u hirotonis prift, duke nisur shërbesën priftërore, 35-vjetori i së cilës kremtohet këtë vit.Përkushtimi i tij ndaj besimit kishte nisur përpara rihapjes së kishave. Gjatë viteve të ndalimit të fesë, duke punuar si fonditor, ai derdhte kryqe dhe ua shpërndante besimtarëve. Në kujtimet e botuara nga Mitropolia e Shenjtë e Korçës dëshmohet edhe angazhimi i tij në përgatitjet për shërbesën e Bekimit të Madh të Ujit, më 6 janar 1991, një nga ngjarjet e rëndësishme të rikthimit të jetës kishtare në qytet.Në vijim, Atë Jani mbajti përgjegjësi të rëndësishme në Kishën Orthodhokse Autoqefale të Shqipërisë. Pas riorganizimit të Sinodit të Shenjtë, në vitin 1998, ai u emërua Kryesekretar i Përgjithshëm i tij.Lidhja e tij me jetën kishtare të komunitetit shqiptar në Boston dëshmohet edhe nga pjesëmarrja në bashkëmeshim me Fortlumturinë e Tij, Kryepiskopin Joan, dhe Episkopin Nikodhim, në Katedralen e Shën Gjergjit, më 8 mars 2026.Nga kryqet e derdhura në vitet e përndjekjes, te shërbesa priftërore dhe përgjegjësitë kishtare, rrugëtimi i Atë Janit ndërthuret me historinë e besimit të ruajtur dhe të jetës kishtare të ringritur në Shqipëri. Urimi i komunitetit të Bostonit shpreh sot afërsinë dhe dashurinë për një klerik që është pjesë e kësaj historie.Për shumë vjet, Atë Jani!Burimi i njoftimit dhe i pamjeve: faqja në Facebook e Katedrales Orthodhokse Shqiptare të Shën Gjergjit, Boston.

items.title_orig: Patriarch of Serbia celebrates Divine Liturgy in Moscow, while visit to Phanar still pending
items.sum:
Patriarku Porfijery i Serbisë vizitoi të dielën, më 22 nëntor 2026, për festën e Shën Nektashrios të Aeginës, ku kryesoi Liturgjinë Hyjnore në kishën e Shenjve Pjetër dhe Pol.

Koncelebrat me patriarkun serb qenë metropolitani Sergius i Singaporit dhe Azisë Juglindore, Metropoliti Nikanor i Banatit, Metropolitan Jovan i Shumadija, Peshkopi Nikolai i Amurit dhe Çegdominit dhe Peshkopi Stefan i Remesianas, kreu i përfaqësuesit patriarkal serb në Moskë, së bashku me klerin e kishës dhe priftërinjtë vizitues dhe monastezët.

Patriarku Porfije është tani në një vizitë shumë-ditore në Moskë, i shoqëruar nga delegacioni i tij kishtar, për të marrë pjesë në festimet që shënojnë 80 vjetorin e patriarkut Kirill të Moskës dhe të gjithë Rusisë.
items.text_orig:
Patriarch Porfirije of Serbia visited the Representation of the Serbian Patriarchate in Moscow on Sunday, November 22, 2026, on the feast of Saint Nektarios of Aegina, where he presided over the Divine Liturgy at the Church of Saints Peter and Paul.

Concelebrating with the Serbian Patriarch were Metropolitan Sergius of Singapore and Southeast Asia, Metropolitan Nikanor of Banat, Metropolitan Jovan of Šumadija, Bishop Nikolai of Amur and Chegdomyn, and Bishop Stefan of Remesiana, head of the Serbian Patriarchal Representation in Moscow, along with clergy of the church and visiting priests and monastics.

The service was attended by numerous Serbian and Russian faithful, including longtime parishioners of the Church of Saints Peter and Paul. Liturgical hymns were performed by a quartet from the choir of Saint Daniel’s Monastery.

A number of Serbian students currently studying in Moscow also attended the Divine Liturgy. Following the service, they had the opportunity to speak with Patriarch Porfirije and take commemorative photographs.

After the reading of the Holy Gospel, the Serbian Patriarch delivered a sermon addressing historical and contemporary issues, Scripture and law, and salvation as revealed through truth.

At the conclusion of the Divine Liturgy, Patriarch Porfirije presented high ecclesiastical distinctions to individuals who have contributed to the maintenance and beautification of the Church of Saints Peter and Paul and the Serbian Patriarchal Representation.

Patriarch Porfirije is currently on a multi-day visit to Moscow, accompanied by his ecclesiastical delegation, to participate in celebrations marking the 80th birthday of Patriarch Kirill of Moscow and All Russia.

It is worth noting, however, that Patriarch Porfirije of Serbia has yet to make an official peace visit to the Ecumenical Patriarchate since his election and enthronement in February 2021.

Such a visit, an established ecclesiastical practice for newly elected Primates of the Local Orthodox Churches, remains pending, even as the Serbian Patriarch once again travels to Moscow to attend celebrations in honor of Patriarch Kirill.

items.title_orig: Patriarch of Romania offers condolences on passing of Metropolitan George Khodr
items.sum:
Patriarku Daniel i Rumanisë i dërgoi një mesazh ngushëllimi patriarkut Xhon X të Antiokisë dhe të gjithë Lindjes të dielën mbrëma pas kalimit të metropolitanit Xhorxh Khorr në moshën 103 vjeç.

E kujtojmë Metropolitin Xhorxh Khor, një teolog dhe shërbëtor i shquar i Kishës, thellësia intelektuale e së cilës, shërbimi baritore dhe nxitja e dialogut ndërfetar në Lindjen e Mesme, e bënë atë shumë të njohur anembanë botës së krishterë sot, tha patriarku Daniel.
items.text_orig:
Patriarch Daniel of Romania sent a message of condolence to Patriarch John X of Antioch and All the East on Sunday evening following the passing of Metropolitan George Khodr at the age of 103.

In his message, the Romanian Patriarch expressed his deep sorrow over the death of the distinguished hierarch of the Patriarchate of Antioch, describing him as an outstanding figure in the Orthodox world.

“We remember Metropolitan George Khodr as a distinguished theologian and servant of the Church, whose intellectual depth, pastoral ministry, and promotion of interreligious dialogue in the Middle East made him widely known throughout the Christian world today,” Patriarch Daniel stated.

The Patriarch also offered prayers for the repose of Metropolitan George Khodr’s soul, invoking Christ as “the Resurrection and the Life” (John 11:25).

“We pray to our Lord Jesus Christ, ‘who is the Resurrection and the Life,’ to grant rest to the soul of Metropolitan George Khodr among the saints who have pleased Him, where there is neither pain, nor sorrow, nor sighing, but life everlasting,” he wrote.

Patriarch Daniel concluded his message with the words: “May his memory be eternal from generation to generation!”

items.title_orig: Archbishop of Australia honours memory of Founders of Church of St. Nectarios in Sydney
items.sum:
Të dielën, më 22 nëntor, të dielën e nëntë të Lukës, kryepeshkopi Makarios i Australisë vizitoi Parishق Kommuniteti i Shën Nektariosit në Burvud, Sidnei. Duke ndihmuar Hirarkët ishin prifti Parish, Fror George Liangas dhe paraardhësi i tij, Fri John Kapetas, ndërsa midis të pranishmëve ishin Presidenti i Komunitetit të Parisit, znj. Penelope Kigsis dhe anëtarë të Këshillit Parish.

Në përfundim të Liturgjisë Hyjnore, kryepeshkopi Makarios vdiq në shërbimin Përkujtimor për të pushuar shpirtrat e të gjithë atyre që i kishin shërbyer Parisit Komuniteti në aftësitë zyrtare, duke përfshirë anëtarë të Këshillit të Parisit, Shoqata Filoptos, komitete të ndryshme dhe personel.

Pas Dismisalit, në oborrin e Kishës, kryepeshkopi Makarios zbuloi një pllakë përkujtimore kushtuar kujtesës së themeluesve të Kishës dhe, në veçanti, kryepeshkopit të ndjerë Ezekiel të Australisë, Arqimandrit të ndjerë Fron Ezekiel Petritsis dhe anëtarëve laikë të Komitetit të parë Parish.

Ai uroi, gjithashtu, priftin Parish, Presidentin dhe bashkëpunëtorët e tyre për kushtimin me të cilin ata nderojnë pionierët e themelimit të Parisit dhe të gjithë ata që, gjatë dekadave, i kanë ofruar shërbimet e tyre për komuniversitetin e Parisit.
items.text_orig:
On Sunday, 22 November, the Ninth Sunday of Luke, Archbishop Makarios of Australia visited the Parish–Community of St Nectarios in Burwood, Sydney. Archbishop Makarios presided over the Matins Service and celebrated the Divine Liturgy, concelebrating with Hirësia e Tij Bishop Elpidios of Perth. Assisting the Hierarchs were the Parish Priest, Fr George Liangas, and his predecessor, Fr John Kapetas, while among those in attendance were the President of the Parish–Community, Ms Penelope Kioussis, and members of the Parish Council. At the invitation of the Archbishop, Hirësia e Tij Bishop Elpidios delivered the sermon.

At the conclusion of the Divine Liturgy, Archbishop Makarios officiated at a Memorial Service for the repose of the souls of all those who had served the Parish–Community in official capacities, including members of the Parish Council, the Ladies’ Philoptochos Society, various committees, and staff.

Following the Dismissal, in the courtyard of the Church, Archbishop Makarios unveiled a commemorative plaque dedicated to the memory of the founders of the Church and, in particular, the late Archbishop Ezekiel of Australia, the late Archimandrite Fr Ezekiel Petritsis, and the lay members of the first Parish Committee.

During his address, the Archbishop expressed the gratitude of the local Church to all those who, from 1970 to the present day, have contributed to the progress and development of the Parish–Community of St Nectarios. He also congratulated the Parish Priest, the President, and their associates for the dedication with which they honour the pioneers of the Parish’s establishment and all those who, over the decades, have offered their services to the Parish–Community.

Indeed, he described this as a commendable attitude, observing with regret that people often believe they themselves have created everything they enjoy today, forgetting those who worked tirelessly in the past to secure better conditions for subsequent generations.

Finally, Archbishop Makarios made special reference to Archimandrite Fr Ezekiel Petritsis, who served the Parish of St Nectarios for 33 years (1970–2003). He described the late clergyman as a pioneer of the Parish and emphasised that he had left a profound spiritual legacy within the local community of Burwood, having baptised, married, administered Holy Communion to, heard the confessions of, and spiritually guided countless parishioners towards salvation.

It is also noted that, during the Divine Liturgy, Archbishop Makarios tonsured two young members of the Parish, Ioannis and George, as Readers. He praised them for their devotion thus far to Christ and His Church and encouraged them to continue progressing spiritually, so that they might one day be deemed worthy of receiving the grace of the priesthood.

Offering paternal advice to the two young men, Archbishop Makarios urged them to strive to teach others not merely through words, but above all through the example of their own lives. “Let your lives become an open book that everyone can read,” he characteristically remarked, bringing his address to a close.
